ctx.x: So there I met John Lewis, and we began to play, and rehearse, and have fun playing music. So I was -- I used to tell him, you know, I knew Dizzy Gillespie and Billy

Eckstine, and everybody would laugh. So when John came to New York, I said, "That's fine. That works out just great, because I'm on my way to rehearsal. Why don't you pass by and pick me up, and I'll give you my address and we'll go together." So he shows up and we go. I said, "Bring that music we used to play when we were in the Army." Because we used to play, "Two Bass Base Hit," but we called it, "Bright Lights," while we were in the Army. So he brought his music along and we went along to rehearsal. So we…
